name: NeRF Pose and Appearance Optimization
definition: A method to jointly optimize camera poses and neural scene representations for unconstrained image collections (varying illumination, transient occluders) without camera pose priors, using surrogate tasks and separate modules for transients.
summary: UP-NeRF jointly optimizes camera poses and neural scene representations for unconstrained images without pose priors, using a candidate head to handle hard poses and transient occluders.
